dataset_spec.name: uci_dermatology
dataset_spec.description: UCI Dermatology erythemato-squamous disease cohort (366 observations, 34 predictors: 12 clinical and 22 histopathological features plus age and family history).
dataset_spec.setting: Patient seen in a dermatology clinic (Ankara and Gazi Universities) with an erythemato-squamous skin disease. Twelve clinical features were scored at examination and twenty-two histopathological features were scored on a skin biopsy; each feature is graded 0 (absent), 1 or 2 (intermediate) or 3 (largest amount possible).
dataset_spec.observations_header: Clinical and histopathological feature scores (0 = absent, 1-2 = intermediate, 3 = maximal):

text_values.0: No family history of these diseases
text_values.1: Family history of these diseases present

vacuolisation_basal_layer.text_label: Vacuolisation and damage of the basal layer

saw_tooth_retes.text_label: Saw-tooth appearance of the rete ridges

dermatological_diagnosis.question: Based on these clinical and histopathological feature scores, which of the six erythemato-squamous diseases is the diagnosis?
